question: Should ClickClack make an optional, persistent channel purpose a supported public channel metadata field across its API, SDK, and two database backends?
rationale: The patch is internally consistent, but the durable user-facing API and metadata model are a product contract that cannot be selected safely from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Sponsor the channel-purpose contract
options.body: Approve the additive field and merge after ordinary maintainer review of the migration and public API surface.

options.title: Defer the metadata feature
options.body: Keep the request open until maintainers choose a broader channel-metadata direction, rather than landing one durable field by default.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the channel-purpose contract
recommendation.body: Approve the additive field and merge after ordinary maintainer review of the migration and public API surface.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main feature-history owner could be established from the supplied review material.
